basis: Independent complete canonical history and selected Introduction readings exposed an unresolved scope; the earlier English case overstated whole-compound attribution.

before.explanation: The Introduction assigns the maqaf compound to the other named manuscripts and printed editions. The doc-note instead assigns those sources the spaced MAM body text with merkha and tipḥa.
before.issue: The Introduction assigns a maqaf to nearby manuscripts and printed editions; the doc-note assigns those sources the spaced text.
before.decision: Choose whether to change the Introduction's attribution to the spaced text, following the doc-note, or revise the doc-note's source attribution.

reading_forms.label: Introduction's uncertain quotation, also attributed to nearby sources

after.explanation: A whole-compound reading of the Introduction gives an apparent attribution mismatch. An accent-only reading may agree with the doc-note. The historical note alternates between grouping these claims and separating them, while its selected MAM pointing stays spaced; history does not settle the Introduction clause’s intended scope.
after.issue: The Introduction's nearby-source agreement clause may concern the complete maqaf compound or specifically merkha; the doc-note gives those sources the spaced MAM text.
after.decision: Clarify what the Introduction's agreement clause covers before proposing any change to the source attribution.

reading_forms.label: Introduction's uncertain quotation; nearby-source clause scope unresolved

limitation: No new manuscript reading, proposal or approval.
